definitions.explanation: A real occurrence or case that illustrates a point or serves as evidence.

examples.japanese: {実例|じつれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げて→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain with an actual example.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{実例|じつれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is one example of a successful case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{実例|じつれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦し→する：00392_suru⟧⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to understand without concrete examples.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {実例|じつれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (to give an example)
- {実例|じつれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (to show an example)
- ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{実例|じつれい} (concrete example)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ - example (general term)
- ⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧ - case, instance (often professional/legal)
- {実例|じつれい} - actual example (emphasizes it really happened)
- ⟦{例|たと}え→例え：04128_tatoe⟧ - analogy, metaphor

{実例|じつれい} emphasizes that the example is a real occurrence, not hypothetical.
